added.exists: This job was already added. Nothing has changed.
added.duplicate: Added, but it looks like a duplicate of <to>job {{id}}</to>, so it stays closed.
added.created: Job added. Your agent will read it when you press “Read new jobs”.

injection.label: Possible injection warning
injection.title: Possible content aimed at an AI
injection.body: The text of this posting might try to manipulate an agent. It's treated only as data, but review it calmly before trusting the extraction.

original.title: Original text
original.hint: Exactly as saved. If it contained instructions for an AI, neither the app nor your agent follows them: they treat it only as data.

events.closureSuspected: {{detail}}. It hasn't been closed: you decide.

note.label: Add a note
note.placeholder: What the recruiter told you, questions, next steps…

archive.pending: No copy of what you sent yet: it's saved automatically a few seconds after you mark it as sent.
archive.label: Archived application
archive.title: Copy of what you sent

missingDetail.title: The job description is missing
missingDetail.body: It came as a summary from an email alert and carries little more than the title and company. For safety your agent doesn't go into LinkedIn, so you complete it yourself with the browser's “Send to CandidatAI” button. Then your agent can read it.
missingDetail.open: Open the job on its job board (on LinkedIn, signed in).
missingDetail.openNoUrl: Look the job up on its job board: no link was saved.
missingDetail.send: In that tab, click the Send to CandidatAI button in the browser toolbar. The description is saved here and the job moves to “To read”.
missingDetail.install: Don't have the button yet? <guide>Install it in a few minutes</guide>.

fitSteps.title: To know whether it fits you
fitSteps.intro: The app calculates the fit (0 to 100) once it has both:
fitSteps.profileHint: Your experience and skills, to compare them with the job.
fitSteps.readHint: It pulls out the level, work mode, skills and salary.
